title: Confused Kaomoji (・・?): Copy & Paste Puzzled Text Faces
meta_description: Copy and paste confused kaomoji: question-mark faces like (・・?), head tilts ( ・◇・)？, uneven eyes (⊙_☉), dizzy (@_@) and clueless shrugs ┐(￣ヘ￣)┌.
hero_tagline: Question marks, tilted heads, mismatched eyes and baffled shrugs. Tap a puzzled face to copy it into any chat.
intro: Confusion in a kaomoji comes from what sits around the face as much as the face itself. A trailing ? or ？ turns any blank look into a question. Eyes of two sizes, as in o_O or (⊙_☉), show a double take. Spiral or @ eyes mean the head is spinning, and arms raised in ┐ ┌ are a shrug that says no idea. A ゞ after the face is a hand scratching the back of the head, which is the classic anime gesture for being lost. Send one when a message makes no sense, when instructions contradict themselves, or when you simply did not follow. The 😕 🤨 emoji versions are on the confused emoji page linked below.

sections.label: Question Mark
sections.intro: The simplest confused face: a blank look with a question mark attached.

sections.label: Head Tilt
sections.intro: The face sits off to one side of its brackets, so it looks turned or tilted.

sections.label: Uneven Eyes
sections.intro: One big eye and one small eye is a double take. Spirals and @ signs are a spinning head.

sections.label: Shrug
sections.intro: Arms up at both sides: the reader has no answer and is not going to pretend otherwise.

sections.label: Head Scratch
sections.intro: ゞ is a raised hand at the back of the head, borrowed from the anime gesture for embarrassment or confusion.

faq.a: It is a double take. One eye is wide and the other is narrow, as if the reader is staring at something odd and not sure they read it right. O.o and (⊙_☉) mean the same thing.

faq.q: What is the ゞ at the end of (・・;)ゞ?
faq.a: ゞ is a Japanese kana repetition mark. In kaomoji its shape stands in for a hand raised to the back of the head, which in anime means confusion or mild embarrassment.

faq.q: Is ┐(￣ヘ￣)┌ the same as the shrug ¯\_(ツ)_/¯?
faq.a: Both are shrugs with arms raised. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ is relaxed and says it does not matter. ┐(￣ヘ￣)┌ has a frowning mouth, so it reads as being stumped rather than unbothered.
